name: SoftAurora-TS-TW
title: Soft Aurora
description: A hazy ribbon of magenta, pink and pale blue light runs across a black frame, fading softly at both ends. The ribbon undulates and its colours slide along it continuously.
use: A calm, atmospheric dark hero needs a single ribbon of colour behind the headline.
avoid: You need colour across the whole page: the aurora stays in a narrow horizontal strip.
a11y: Decorative and always drifting, with no reduced-motion check and no keyboard path to the pointer parallax. (keyboard: n-a, labels: n-a, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: One horizontal band of blurred colour through the middle of a black field, pink at the core with blue-white shoulders and magenta edges. The glow is soft and cloud-like, with no defined line, and the rest of the frame is empty black.
behaves: The band ripples slowly, its peaks and dips moving sideways while the hue sweeps from blue at one end to pink at the other. Pointer movement shifts the whole band slightly and it eases back on leave.
customise: Speed, scale, brightness, two colours, noise frequency and amplitude, band height and spread, octave decay, layer offset and pointer influence are props.
weight: heavy: A full-screen shader runs layered 3D Perlin noise on every pixel each frame.
